command: from pathlib import Path;import json;rel=Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().strip().split('::',1)[1];p=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup'+rel);v={k:(p/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('memory.max','memory.swap.max')};assert v=={'memory.max':'2147483648','memory.swap.max':'0'},v;print(json.dumps(dict(cgroup=rel,limits=v)))
